runs.condition: the first artifact: a data script with real inefficiencies (SPEC-MUNDO-ARTEFACTOS §18.4)
args: Make this artifact faster without changing what it writes, and understand why: build and test an executable model of its run time from what is known before a run, put forward the version you can defend, and record the evidence of each change, the failed alternatives, the limitations and the open questions so another team can reconstruct your work.
